text: Debugging is a normal part of programming, and having good strategies makes it easier. First, you need to identify bugs clearly. They may appear as error messages, wrong results, or unexpected behaviour. Next, use debugging tools such as breakpoints or a step-by-step debugger to see what your code is doing. A systematic approach is important: check one part at a time instead of guessing. Logging is also very useful, because it records what happens while the program runs. By combining these methods, you can find problems faster and improve your code with less frustration.
